story: Lake Pueblo State Park is a state park located in Pueblo County, Colorado. It includes 60 miles of shoreline and 10,000 acres of land. The land surrounding the reservoir is very diverse and home to many different animal species.
matters: Water from Pueblo helps enhance recreation, fish, and wildlife. It is also notable in that it is home to a rare species of serpent, the blackneck garter snake.
name: Lake Pueblo State Park
